title: Free Time
text:
I like my free time very much. On Saturdays, I play football with my friends. We play in the park near my house. After the game, we eat ice cream. I am always happy on Saturdays.

On Sundays, I read books at home. My favorite book is about animals. My sister likes to draw pictures. She draws cats and dogs. We have fun together on Sundays.

questions.text: Who does the writer play football with?
What does the sister like to draw?
Why is the writer always happy on Saturdays?
options: Because they play football with friends
Because they go to bed early

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about reading?
options: They do it only at school

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people can play
the one you like more than all the others
to make a picture with a pencil or pen

paragraph_translations: Boş zamanımı çok severim. Cumartesileri arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Evimin yakınındaki parkta oynarız. Maçtan sonra dondurma yeriz. Cumartesileri her zaman mutluyum.
Pazarları evde kitap okurum. En sevdiğim kitap hayvanlar hakkında. Kız kardeşim resim çizmeyi sever. Kediler ve köpekler çizer. Pazarları birlikte eğlenceli vakit geçiririz.
